apiKeys.description: Keys act as their owner inside this project, limited to the permissions they were given.

table.emptyDescription: Create one to talk to the API without a browser session.
table.revokeDescription: {{name}} stops working immediately. Anything using it will start getting 401s.

createDialog.title: Create API key
createDialog.descriptionProject: The key can only act inside this project, and never beyond your own permissions.
createDialog.descriptionInstance: The key acts across the instance, and never beyond your own permissions.
createDialog.copyDescription: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it somewhere safe — if you lose it, create a new one.

editDialog.title: Edit API key
editDialog.description: The scope is fixed when a key is created; its name and permissions are not.

permissionsField.serverDescription: Applied to every server the key's owner can access.

databases.description: Each database comes with its own user and connection string.

instanceView.notRunningDescription: Start it before creating databases or users — the engine has to be up for those to take effect.

deleteCard.title: Delete instance
deleteCard.description: Removing this instance also removes every database and user on it.
deleteCard.confirmDescription: Every database and user on this instance is deleted with it, along with all of their data. This cannot be undone.

createDialog.title: Create database
createDialog.description: Pick a name and an engine. A user with full access is created with it.
createDialog.nameDescription: Letters and digits only, 2 to 63 characters. Also used as the username.
createDialog.submitting: Creating, this can take a minute

databasesCard.description: As many as you need on this instance. Each one is reachable through the shared instance address.
databasesCard.createDialogDescription: Letters and digits only, up to 63 characters.
databasesCard.deleteDescription: The database, all of its data and every user granted on it are deleted.

usersCard.description: Each one connects with the name shown, which carries its own id.
usersCard.emptyDescription: Create one to get a connection string.
usersCard.connectionUriCopyFailed: Failed to copy the connection URI
usersCard.createDialogDescription: A password is generated for you and shown once the user exists. Grant it on as many databases as you need.
usersCard.deleteDescription: Anything still connecting with these credentials stops working.
usersCard.noDatabasesHint: This instance has no databases yet.
usersCard.accessDialogDescription: Pick what {{name}} may do in each database. Changes take effect on the engine right away.
usersCard.accessError: Failed to update the database access

managementBar.suspendedTooltip: An administrator suspended this instance. Connections are rejected and power actions are blocked.
managementBar.addressCopyFailed: Failed to copy the instance address
managementBar.noPowerPermission: You do not have permission to control power.
managementBar.powerError: Failed to change the power state

list.emptyDescription: Create one to get a connection string.
list.deleteDescription: The database, all of its data and every user granted on it are deleted. This cannot be undone.

members.description: Add people and grant them specific permissions

table.emptyDescription: Invite someone to give them access to this project.
table.removeDescription: This will remove {{email}} from the project. They will lose access to all of its servers.

inviteDialog.title: Add Member
inviteDialog.description: Add a member by email and grant them specific permissions.

updateDialog.title: Member Permissions
updateDialog.description: Choose exactly what this member can do in the project's servers.

expiry.label: Access duration
expiry.limitDescription: The member loses access automatically once the expiry passes.

dangerZone.title: Danger Zone
dangerZone.deleteWarning: Deleting your project will permanently remove all associated data, including servers, members, databases, and API keys. This action cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete project?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes {{name}} and everything in it. This action cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.notEmpty: The project still has servers. Delete them first.

logoCard.title: Project Logo
logoCard.description: A PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image of at most 2 MiB.
logoCard.invalid: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image of at most 2 MiB

nameCard.title: Project Name
nameCard.label: Please enter your project name
nameCard.description: This action will update the name of the project.

slugCard.title: Project Slug
slugCard.label: Please enter a unique slug
slugCard.hint: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

dashboard.heading: Your Servers
dashboard.subheading: Manage your game servers, view logs, and access the console.
dashboard.noProjectDescription: Please select a project before viewing servers.
dashboard.emptyDescription: This project doesn't have any game servers yet.

domains.description: Use domains you own for your routes. Each domain needs a few DNS records before it can be used.
domains.recordsPending: Create these records at your domain's DNS provider.
domains.recordsVerified: Keep these records in place so routes and certificates keep working.
domains.pendingHelp: The domain is checked every few minutes. Domains that are not verified within a week are removed.
domains.deleteDescription: Routes on this domain have to be removed first. Records at your DNS provider are not changed.

addDialog.title: Add domain
addDialog.description: Enter a domain you own. Its subdomains can be used for routes once it is verified.
addDialog.domainInvalid: Enter a valid domain such as example.com.
